notes.title: Devlog 03. Playtest Announcement
notes.notes: [p]This is the 3rd development log.[/p][p]We're sharing updates on the playtest build currently in preparation.[/p][p][/p][h3]Title Screen[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/cfbb2792f457eb88d819cfbc7c1aa0ed51fc87c0.png"][/img][/p][p]This is the title screen of the playtest build.[/p][p]You can see the four main characters.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Character's Unique Skill[/h3][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/0d892ec0307165daa2b1e80a04abcb3b30a0d09c.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/b9b3d2cd8b602266415afe30cc184faed7e41289.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/2bcffa4b0eb7699fa3eff0f907688febe3b7e40a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/af5dd25cd82f612b1a9341dc15373be3ca918cdb.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]Each character has a unique skill.[/p][p]Skills are incredibly powerful elements that can change the course of battle.[/p][p]Use your skills wisely to gain a tactical advantage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Tutorial[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/3a379b55b3e56906dc695165a65942cea38dca87.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The tutorial stage has been completed.[/p][p]In this stage, you'll meet the troublemakers of Zero Squad.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Playtest[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/cee931baa2d0634891e42d77e0e03a690db1ccae.png"][/img][/p][p]A Steam playtest is coming soon.[/p][p]The playtest will feature a tutorial mission and three story missions.[/p][p]Join our Discord server to provide direct feedback and suggestions to the developers.[/p][p]We look forward to your participation.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Devlog 02. Status
notes.notes: [p]This is the second devlog.[/p][p]In this post, I will tell you about the current status of Alignment Zero.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Character Work[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/41f83d8fd6b6c9958ea2f32e75808e9474da2884.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/500296b2618eb54768c59ebe80dae3db59c07add.png"][/img][/p][p](Character design of the regular platoon members, the assaulter and the sniper)[/p][p][/p][p]Currently designing the initial four regular characters that appear in Alignment Zero.[/p][p]These are the members of the platoon that the player will first command.[/p][p]Let me introduce two of them.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Game System[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/6e7d9f3539c723f77f8d1392acada1966fb63072.gif"][/img][/p][p](Tactical Planning System)[/p][p][/p][p]In order to strengthen the tactical elements in real-time game, a system called [b]Tactical Planning[/b] was introduced.[/p][p]Basically, units perform combat actions autonomously, but it is a system that can create and control action plans when necessary.[/p][p]You can collect various tactics and use various plays by combining characters and tactics.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/729eae69c964533fc44c85d9412f447cab320c23.gif"][/img][/p][p](Suppression System)[/p][p][/p][p]The yellow gauge below the HP bar is the [b]Suppression[/b] value.[/p][p]When units being attacked, the suppression value increases, and when it reaches its maximum, unit will be [b]Suppressed[/b].[/p][p]The suppression status will remain until the suppression value drops to 0.[/p][p]When suppressed, the unit will stop your tactical plan, cannot attack, and will prioritize cover actions for self-defense.[/p][p]It is important to create a tactical plan so that your allies do not fall into the suppression status and so that your enemies fall into the suppression status.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]('Alignment Zero' is currently under development and the content may change in the future.)[/p]

notes.title: Devlog 01. Tactical Planning System
notes.notes: [p]This is the first devlog.[/p][p]I would like to introduce a little bit of what kind of game this is through this post.[/p][p][/p][p]'Alignment Zero' is a real-time tactics (RTT) genre.[/p][p]RTT is similar to real-time strategy (RTS), but it is a genre that does not have strategic concepts such as resources or unit production.[/p][p][/p][p]The player becomes a commander and organizes and commands a 4-person squad.[/p][p]The battle is conducted in real time, but AZ has an system called a Tactical Planning.[/p][p][/p][p]You can plan where the unit will move, what actions to take at a specific point, etc., and execute them at the desired time.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/d0d8613469c81cf1aa8529d5a16a94e1f568a92a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Tactical Planning System allows you to command your units more tactically.[/p][p]For example, if you plan to have two units start a suppressive fire and then move the remaining two units to a cover position, you can minimize damage while moving.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42525439/51decef6ebc279c261965eaa2736dac10562959d.png"][/img][/p][p]The core element of the game is to create a tactical plan that suits the situation, gain a tactical advantage, and win the battle.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]('Alignment Zero' is currently under development and the content may change in the future.)[/p]
